purpose: To bind the WOW v2 discovery track cryptographically to the closed WOW v1 method study without granting v2 any ability to modify it.

v1_reference.external_anchors: Public gist ce684172f700759ec9df328d83d4556e (files wow1-anchor.txt and WOW1_CLOSURE_2026-08-18.md) plus two OpenTimestamps commitments dated 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-18.
v1_reference.attestation_state: PENDING. Until the OpenTimestamps commitments are Bitcoin-attested, only integrity and reproducibility may be claimed, never existence no later than a given date.

immutability_rule.statement: WOW v2 may reference WOW v1 artifacts and may re-derive their identities. WOW v2 may never modify, supersede, re-seal or re-interpret any WOW v1 sealed or pinned artifact, and may never move the wow-v1.0 tag.
immutability_rule.if_v1_appears_wrong: A defect discovered in a WOW v1 artifact is recorded as a WOW v2 finding against the frozen v1 state. The v1 chain is not edited. The correct response is a new record in v2, never a rewrite in v1.
immutability_rule.scope_exclusions: No G0 work, no facility capability verification, no network solver work, no regression tests for the v1 solver, and no v1 verification debt is closed inside WOW v2.

naming_rule.hazard: In WOW v1 the token WOW-2 denotes the retrospective evidence layer (WOW-2 pin 877eedfe...). Using WOW-2 for this successor project would collide with that meaning.
naming_rule.resolution: This project is named WOW V2 or WOW DISCOVERY in prose and WOW_V2 in artifact identifiers. The token WOW-2 continues to mean the v1 retrospective layer and nothing else.

v2_purpose: To determine whether EVE can identify a genuinely novel, testable scientific candidate, relationship, inconsistency, prediction, or previously untested proposition concerning the Wow! Signal itself. This is not an extension of G0 or of network verification.
